Because the trellis history dates every edge, the fable audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 5 epochs of prior interaction to count. Bonded capital sits idle for 16 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
